metrics.name: shopify_orders
metrics.title: Shopify orders
metrics.description: Orders placed in Shopify in the window.

metrics.name: shopify_net_revenue
metrics.title: Shopify net revenue
metrics.description: Sum of each order's current total in Shopify, after discounts, edits and refunds, for orders in the window. Cancelled orders are left out.

metrics.name: average_order_value
metrics.title: Average order value
metrics.description: Shopify net revenue divided by Shopify orders.

metrics.name: returning_order_share
metrics.title: Returning order share
metrics.description: Share of Shopify orders placed by customers who had ordered before.

metrics.name: flow_attributed_revenue
metrics.title: Flow attributed revenue
metrics.description: Revenue Klaviyo attributes to all flows in the window.

metrics.name: flow_revenue_share
metrics.title: Flow share of revenue
metrics.description: Flow attributed revenue as a share of Shopify net revenue.

metrics.name: flow_revenue_per_recipient
metrics.title: Revenue per flow recipient
metrics.description: Flow attributed revenue divided by flow recipients, across all flows.

metrics.name: flow_unsubscribe_rate
metrics.title: Flow unsubscribe rate
metrics.description: Unsubscribes divided by flow recipients.

metrics.name: flow_spam_rate
metrics.title: Flow spam complaint rate
metrics.description: Spam complaints divided by flow recipients.

metrics.name: klaviyo_placed_orders
metrics.title: Klaviyo Placed Order count
metrics.description: Placed Order events Klaviyo recorded in the window. Compare with shopify_orders: they should be close.

metrics.name: ga4_sessions
metrics.title: GA4 sessions
metrics.description: Sessions GA4 recorded in the window, all channels.

metrics.name: stripe_net_revenue
metrics.title: Stripe net revenue
metrics.description: Successful Stripe charges minus amounts refunded on them, for charges made in the window.

metrics.name: stripe_repeat_charge_share
metrics.title: Stripe repeat charge share
metrics.description: Share of successful Stripe charges from customers who had paid before.

metrics.name: stripe_failed_payment_rate
metrics.title: Stripe failed payment rate
metrics.description: Failed Stripe charges divided by all attempted charges.

metrics.name: stripe_subscriptions_started
metrics.title: Subscriptions started
metrics.description: Stripe subscriptions created in the window.

metrics.name: stripe_subscriptions_ended
metrics.title: Subscriptions ended
metrics.description: Stripe subscriptions that ended in the window: canceled and gone, not just set to cancel later.

metrics.name: stripe_mrr
metrics.title: Stripe MRR
metrics.description: Monthly recurring revenue at the last sync: active and past_due subscriptions at list price, scaled to a month. Ignores the window.

metrics.name: meta_ad_spend
metrics.title: Meta ad spend
metrics.description: What the Meta ad account spent in the window.

metrics.name: meta_attributed_purchases
metrics.title: Meta attributed purchases
metrics.description: Purchases Meta attributes to its ads in the window.

metrics.name: meta_reported_roas
metrics.title: Meta reported ROAS
metrics.description: Purchase value Meta attributes to its ads, divided by spend. Meta's own claim.

metrics.name: marketing_efficiency_ratio
metrics.title: Marketing efficiency ratio
metrics.description: Shopify net revenue divided by Meta ad spend. All store revenue over ad spend, with no attribution at all.

metrics.name: ga4_purchase_rate
metrics.title: GA4 purchase rate
metrics.description: GA4 purchases divided by GA4 sessions.
